purpose: Detect gamer/otaku terminology errors before approving a glossary. These invented sentences are not quotations from the copyrighted novel and are not evidence of chapter canon.

cases.source: Oknodie gained one level after the trial.
cases.expected_es: Oknodie subió un nivel después de la prueba.
cases.risk: Do not split, translate, or respell Oknodie.

cases.source: She farmed low-level monsters to gain experience.
cases.expected_es: Farmeó monstruos de bajo nivel para ganar experiencia.
cases.risk: A dictionary translation such as 'cultivó monstruos' loses the game mechanic.

cases.source: The villagers returned to the farm before sunset.
cases.expected_es: Los aldeanos regresaron a la granja antes del atardecer.
cases.risk: A global replacement of farm with 'farmear' would be wrong.

cases.source: The Steal skill failed, so she tried to steal the key herself.
cases.expected_es: La habilidad Steal falló, así que intentó robar la llave ella misma.
cases.risk: One global replacement cannot reliably handle the skill label and ordinary verb in the same sentence.

cases.source: Everyone called the tsundere girl cold, but Oknodie knew better.
cases.expected_es: Todos llamaban fría a la chica tsundere, pero Oknodie sabía que no era así.
cases.risk: Flattening tsundere to only 'fría' loses the archetype.

cases.source: Her build focused on Luck instead of Strength.
cases.expected_es: Su build se centraba en Suerte en lugar de Fuerza.
cases.risk: Build can mean construction outside gaming; use context.

cases.source: The monster dropped a rare item.
cases.expected_es: El monstruo soltó un objeto raro.
cases.risk: Translating every occurrence of drop as 'botín' can break sentence grammar.

cases.source: The next level of the tower was sealed.
cases.expected_es: El siguiente piso de la torre estaba sellado.
cases.risk: Level does not always mean character level.

cases.source: He was min-maxing Luck to survive the early game.
cases.expected_es: Estaba optimizando al máximo la Suerte para sobrevivir a la fase inicial del juego.
cases.risk: Literal word-by-word translation loses the strategy concept.
